deserialized.description:
If `true` data will be deserialized on Dataset#read and Dataset#cache operations. Otherwise it will be read or
cached in raw form, typically bytes.

serType.description: Data serialization type. If not provide type will be inferred from source data

cache.description: If `true` data will be cached in memory immediately on Dataset construction

save.description: If `true` snapshot of the data will be saved in a persisted store immediately on Dataset construction

saveLowLatency.description: If `true` snapshot of the data will be saved in a low latency persisted store immediately on Dataset construction

parallelReadChunkSizeMb.description: Suggested data size for a single chunk when using parallel reads

disableParallelRead.description: Do not use parallel reads from file system / database, I.e. each file will be read serially.

disableStringPooling.description: Do not use string pooling, i.e. do not use single instance for duplicate strings.

enableObjectPooling.description: Use single instance for all duplicate objects

server.description: Server id where data for this dataset lives
